comparison.objective: Empty four concentrate bottles into a filling tank and close its inlet valve at the target level; candidate separates dry media and washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated liquid pouring plus timing a valve closure versus pouring a rigid mixture and mobilizing orientation-dependent media through a screen.
comparison.success_condition: All bottles emptied, valve shut, level within 12.5–13.5 cm, with overflow/spill vetoes; candidate requires ≥98% solid-media recovery and all washers retained.
comparison.reason: Both include pouring and spill control, but liquid batching/valve timing does not test selective passage, bridging or retained workpieces.
